newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Tobacco to raise cigarette prices by 10 yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan Tobacco to raise cigarette prices by 10 yen.

text.p: Japan Tobacco Inc said on Thursday it would increase the price of 23 brands of cigarettes by 10 yen on April 1 in conjunction with the expected rise in Japan's sales tax from three to five percent.
The company said that all of its brands, except for six which are priced lower than 220 yen, will be affected by the price increase.
It will also raise the price of eight Marlboro brands by 10 yen, the company said in a statement.
